action_evidence_table.description: Retain the baseline consequence envelope without an additional recovery intervention.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Identity comparator; no intervention leaves baseline state and consequence envelope unchanged.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: Always available as the no-additional-recovery identity action.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: deterministic identity C_a=C_0
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: baseline comparator only; formally executable

action_evidence_table.description: Hold a departure within an explicitly bounded window to protect connecting passengers.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Holding a departure can preserve a connection but consumes schedule slack and may transfer delay to the held flight and later rotation.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A protected connection exists and both flight and passenger-control authority are available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: bounded hold response and passenger linkage are scenario parameters
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional C_a envelope; P_itinerary support currently incomplete

action_evidence_table.action_name: Cruise speed or flight time adjustment
action_evidence_table.description: Adjust cruise speed or planned flight time to trade delay recovery against operating burden.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Cruise-time adjustment trades flight execution time against fuel, crew, safety and network operating burden.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A feasible cruise-time adjustment range exists within aircraft and operational limits.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: speed-to-time and burden response curve is not identified in Data2
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional C_a envelope; cannot be authoritative without calibrated response

action_evidence_table.description: Apply a bounded departure-time change while preserving declared schedule and rotation constraints.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Bounded retiming changes departure and successor rotation timing, potentially reducing propagation while moving schedule and passenger exposure.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: The successor flight can be retimed inside a declared operational window.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: retiming effect is represented by declared scenario parameters
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional ranking lane only until response support and M4 mapping are frozen

action_evidence_table.description: Coordinate a slot or ATFM timing change to reduce execution and propagation exposure.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Slot or ATFM coordination changes the feasible departure window under network capacity constraints.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A slot or ATFM coordination opportunity and relevant authority are available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: slot opportunity and response magnitude are scenario inputs
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional C_a envelope; no authoritative monetary ranking

action_evidence_table.description: Request departure priority or sequence adjustment within a declared capacity window.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Departure prioritization changes sequence position and may reduce delay for one flight while displacing capacity or delay elsewhere.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A priority or sequence-request window is open and ATFM authority is available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: priority-induced displacement remains scenario-only
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional C_a envelope; shared network burden must be represented

action_evidence_table.description: Reaccommodate disrupted passengers onto feasible alternative itineraries.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Reaccommodation changes passenger itinerary outcomes and may consume seats or create additional operating assignments.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: Passenger itineraries and feasible alternative capacity are available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: passenger alternative and service response are not observed in Data2
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional only; P_itinerary/P_service are currently ABSTAIN

action_evidence_table.description: Expedite a passenger transfer using declared ground resources and connection constraints.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Expedited transfer can preserve a connection by consuming scarce ground-transfer time and resources.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A connection is at risk and an explicit ground-transfer resource is available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: transfer success and service burden require scenario parameters
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional only; passenger components block formal ranking

action_evidence_table.description: Activate passenger-care services without representing the service as flight-delay mitigation.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Passenger-care activation changes service exposure and may reduce service-related consequence without changing aircraft movement directly.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: Passenger disruption exposure is present and the declared care service is available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: care response is not a flight-delay response and has no observed action log
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional only; P_service support incomplete

action_evidence_table.description: Reassign the aircraft to a compatible gate or stand during disruption recovery.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Gate or stand reassignment resolves resource conflict and can preserve aircraft execution and continuity.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A compatible gate or stand is available during the required occupancy interval.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: gate resource state and response duration are unavailable in Data2
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; formal response requires ground-resource evidence

action_evidence_table.description: Reinforce ground support to compress a feasible subset of remaining turnaround tasks.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Additional ground support can shorten feasible turnaround tasks while consuming compatible staff/equipment.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: Additional compatible ground-handling resources can be assigned to the turnaround.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: task compression curve is scenario-only
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional C_a envelope; no current empirical parameter

cost_risk_implications: tow time, coordination and safety burden
action_evidence_table.description: Tow or reposition an aircraft between compatible stands as part of ground recovery.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Tow or stand reposition changes ground location to unlock gate or turnaround feasibility.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A tow path, destination stand, tug and stand resources are simultaneously available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: tow duration and consequence response are scenario inputs
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; ground support not formally measured

action_evidence_table.description: Swap the disrupted aircraft with an available compatible aircraft from the same fleet.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Same-fleet aircraft swap restores flight coverage and changes aircraft continuity and downstream propagation.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A same-fleet replacement aircraft is available and operationally compatible.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: replacement aircraft inventory and response effect are not observed
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional C_a envelope; aircraft response parameters not frozen for formal M4

action_evidence_table.description: Reassign aircraft among local rotations to restore feasible flight coverage.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Local rotation reassignment redistributes aircraft across nearby legs to restore continuity.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A feasible local rotation reassignment exists and preserves aircraft continuity constraints.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: rotation reassignment is scenario-only
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; no formal action-effect artifact

action_evidence_table.description: Activate a compatible standby aircraft to cover disrupted flight execution.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Standby activation supplies replacement capacity before an execution deadline.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A standby aircraft is available, compatible and can be activated before the execution deadline.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: standby inventory and activation response are not present in Data2
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; cannot rank authoritatively

action_evidence_table.description: Substitute equipment across fleets subject to explicit compatibility and capacity constraints.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Cross-fleet substitution restores capacity under stricter type, crew and passenger-capacity constraints.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A cross-fleet substitute satisfies type, capacity, crew and airport compatibility constraints.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: cross-fleet compatibility and effect magnitude are scenario-only
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; M2 passenger support incomplete

cost_risk_implications: ferry cost and immediate operating burden
action_evidence_table.description: Ferry an aircraft to the disrupted location to restore later rotation coverage.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Ferry reposition places an aircraft at a future recovery location and consumes time, crew and network capacity.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A repositionable aircraft, crew, slots and ferry authority are available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: ferry route and response are not observed in Data2
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; no formal response support

action_evidence_table.description: Swap to another legally qualified crew for the affected flight or duty sequence.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Qualified crew swap restores duty coverage and can reduce execution and propagation disruption.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A replacement crew with matching qualifications and legal duty time is available.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: crew roster and duty response are absent from Data2
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; no empirical crew response

action_evidence_table.description: Activate a reserve crew to replace an unavailable or disrupted crew.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Reserve crew activation supplies legal coverage for a disrupted duty sequence.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A reserve crew can report before the execution deadline and remains duty legal.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: reserve pool and activation effect are scenario-only
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; no formal M4 ranking

action_evidence_table.description: Reposition or deadhead crew to restore coverage at a different station.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Crew reposition or deadhead moves qualified crew between stations to repair coverage.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A feasible reposition or deadhead path exists within duty and transport constraints.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: deadhead feasibility and consequence response are not observed
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; P_time and crew burden require support

action_evidence_table.description: Repair the disrupted crew schedule by rescheduling legal duty sequences.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Crew-duty rescheduling changes legal pairings and rest sequencing to preserve future execution.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: A revised crew-duty sequence satisfies qualification, rest and duty-time rules.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: crew-duty response is scenario-only
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; no formal crew artifact

action_evidence_table.description: Cancel the successor flight under explicit network, resource and passenger consequence accounting.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Flight cancellation removes an execution obligation but transfers consequences to passengers, aircraft rotation, crew and service.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: Cancellation authority exists and passenger, aircraft and crew consequences are explicitly represented.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: downstream passenger, crew and network effects require scenario parameters
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; current M2 passenger components ABSTAIN

cost_risk_implications: large cancellation, itinerary and service burden
action_evidence_table.description: Cancel a downstream leg and truncate the associated rotation with full downstream consequence accounting.
action_evidence_table.effect_mechanism: Downstream cancellation or rotation truncation removes later obligations while exposing continuity, passenger and service consequences.
action_evidence_table.eligibility_condition: Network truncation authority exists and all affected downstream legs and resources are identified.
action_evidence_table.implementation_assumption: full downstream response is not identifiable from current Data2 artifacts
action_evidence_table.m4_relevance: conditional scenario lane; no authoritative residual-risk ranking

exp3_readiness_impact.interpretation: Non-A00 responses carry ASSUMPTION_GROUNDED mechanism provenance with LOW/BASE/HIGH bands and enter the SCENARIO/CONDITIONAL lane; authoritative ranking remains gated by the M4 material-coverage freeze.

remaining_blockers: Non-A00 response magnitudes are assumption-grounded mechanism responses with LOW/BASE/HIGH bands, not empirical action effects.
P_itinerary and P_service are ASSUMPTION_GROUNDED (literature-parameterized), not empirical, in the current M2 artifact.
M4 production mapping and authoritative residual-risk ranking remain unfrozen.
Data2 contains no observed action log for empirical response validation.
